master.name: Master profile
master.summary: Product designer with 6+ years of experience turning complex problems into thoughtful, accessible digital experiences. I bring together research, systems thinking, and a love of craft to build products that work beautifully for people.

experience.title: Senior Product Designer
experience.bullets:
Led end-to-end design for a B2B platform serving 12,000+ teams, improving activation by 28%.
Built a design system with 60+ components, reducing design-to-development time by 35%.
Partnered with product and engineering to translate user research into a focused product roadmap.

experience.title: Product Designer
experience.bullets:
Designed web and mobile experiences for clients in education, wellness, and financial services.
Conducted 40+ user interviews and usability studies to inform evidence-based design decisions.

education.bullets: Graduated with honours · Design Society member

skills.name: Design
skills.items: Product strategy, User research, Interaction design, Prototyping, Accessibility

skills.name: Tools
skills.items: Figma, FigJam, Adobe Creative Suite, HTML & CSS

projects.name: Open Path
projects.description: An accessible trip-planning concept that helps people explore their city with confidence.
